description: CITTA METROPOLITANA MILANO - Dispositivi accertamento infrazioni strade provinciali is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Lombardia. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
